CI_snapshot_timing: One read per endpoint except before/after immutable named-ref brackets; checks and jobs may reflect legitimate completion between reads, no global atomicity claim. No polling.

Documentation_improvement.Canonical_file_changed_or_proposed: Verified accepted exact reuse in docs/skills/repository-operations.md; source unchanged.
Documentation_improvement.Durable_learning_captured: PR and push event namespaces and changed-file sets must separately determine workflows/jobs; late dependent publishers and inaccessible protection remain explicit. Source/control metadata is distinct from actual receipt qualification.

Exact_deltas.exact_delta:
Evaluate workflow path filters against the event's own changed-file set: a PR
uses its base/head comparison, while a named branch push uses the authenticated
before/after update. A merged target can trigger a push-only Copilot path filter
even when that workflow is excluded from the PR set. Tag-only push filters do
not admit a branch update; keep these namespaces and auxiliary jobs separate.

An empty visible ruleset list does not resolve an inaccessible traditional
branch-protection endpoint. Bracket a paginated census with live named-ref
readbacks. If the target advances during collection, retain the old tuple and
query the new head separately; do not transfer its predecessor's passing CI.
